name: iam:PassRole + imagebuilder:CreateComponent + imagebuilder:CreateImageRecipe + imagebuilder:CreateInfrastructureConfiguration + imagebuilder:CreateImage
description: A principal with iam:PassRole and EC2 Image Builder creation permissions can escalate privileges by building a pipeline: create a component containing malicious shell commands, add it to an image recipe, create an infrastructure configuration that passes an admin IAM instance profile, then trigger an image build. The Image Builder agent runs the component shell commands on an EC2 build instance with admin credentials available via IMDS.
author: Zander Mackie (Datadog)

required.description: Must be able to pass the target admin IAM instance profile role to the EC2 Image Builder service

additional.description: Required in some regions or configurations
Find the base AMI for the image recipe
Discover existing images and build status

admin: A role must exist that can be used as an EC2 instance profile (trusts ec2.amazonaws.com)
The role must have administrative permissions (e.g., AdministratorAccess or equivalent)
The AWS Image Builder service-linked role (AWSServiceRoleForImageBuilder) must exist in the account
lateral: A role must exist that can be used as an EC2 instance profile and has elevated permissions
The AWSServiceRoleForImageBuilder SLR must exist in the account

references.title: Actions defined by EC2 Image Builder
Security best practices in EC2 Image Builder

options.name: INSTANCE_PROFILE
options.description: Admin IAM instance profile NAME to pass to the Image Builder build EC2 instance (not ARN — the API requires the profile name)

options.name: TARGET_ARN
options.description: IAM user or role name/ARN to attach AdministratorAccess to (auto-resolved from caller identity if not set)

options.name: REGION
options.description: AWS region for Image Builder resources

options.name: SUBNET_ID
options.description: Subnet ID for the Image Builder build EC2 instance (uses default VPC subnet if omitted)

options.name: SECURITY_GROUP_ID
options.description: Security group ID for the build EC2 instance (optional; Image Builder uses the default SG if omitted)

options.name: POLICY_ARN
options.description: Policy ARN to attach to TARGET_ARN via the build component

options.name: COMPONENT_NAME
options.description: Name prefix for the Image Builder component (auto-generated if omitted)

options.name: CLEANUP
options.description: Delete Image Builder resources after execution (note: the starting user typically lacks imagebuilder:Delete* — use workspace cleanup with admin credentials)

payloads.name: backdoor/attach-policy
payloads.description: Attach AdministratorAccess to an IAM user or role via EC2 Image Builder component using IMDS credentials
